attributes.action: Restore Public Confidence with a New General Election
attributes.additional_details: We call on the UK Government and Parliament to hold an immediate General Election. Many voters feel the current Labour Government no longer reflects their views. There are concerns over the economy, public services, immigration, taxation and the cost of living. A new election would allow the British people to decide who should govern and provide the next Government with a clear democratic mandate. The public should have the opportunity to have its voice heard through the ballot box.
attributes.background: We call on the UK Government and Parliament to hold an immediate General Election. Many voters feel the current Labour Government no longer represents their views and that public confidence has been lost. The British people should have the opportunity to choose who governs the country.
